findings.text: The component has 2 nodes; wsrep_cluster_address names 3 (this node included), and mf-pxc-2 is not in the component: it may be down or still joining.

findings.title: Cannot survive another failure
findings.text: With 2 nodes in the Primary component, losing one more by a crash or a network partition leaves the rest without a majority, so they go non-Primary and stop accepting writes (assumes equal pc.weight).

notes: Failures tolerated assumes equal pc.weight on every node (the default): a Primary component needs more than half of the total weight.
wsrep_flow_control_paused and the queue averages cover the time since the provider's statistics were last reset (FLUSH STATUS) or since start.
The other nodes' states come from performance_schema.pxc_cluster_view on this node; this node's own from wsrep_local_state_comment.
